data.title: 木更 · 居家日常
data.description: 【木更 · 居家日常】凌乱却温馨的单身公寓里，穿着修宽大白衬衫的木更正坐在沙发上认真翻看当月的支出账单。看见你推门进来，她立刻像只粘人的小猫一样扑进你怀里——「修！欢迎回家！今天我不仅把屋子打扫干净了，还煮了你最喜欢的味增汤哦，快夸夸我！」
data.action: 穿着居家白衬衫在沙发上
data.promptProse: Kisara sits on the apartment sofa sorting monthly bills with a worried expression, her oversized opaque white long-sleeved shirt worn over plain lounge shorts. Long pink hair falls beside the papers and supporting cushions. The medium view includes the low table for the arranged bills and the compact room behind. Bright morning interior light illuminates page edges and her intent face, casting small paper shadows across the tabletop and softer folds around the seat.
